name: command
description: Command menu for search and quick actions, with groups, shortcuts, and an optional dialog palette.
purpose: Lets people filter and run commands or jump to destinations without leaving the current page.
bestFor: grouped shortcuts for settings and navigation
avoidFor: simple single-select fields; use a select or combobox
long-form navigation that belongs on a page
